title: Career Roadmap — Creative Strategist
summary: A Creative Strategist combines creativity, audience research, brand positioning and business objectives to develop effective advertising campaigns and content strategies. The role involves understanding consumer behaviour, identifying insights, developing campaign concepts and collaborating with designers, copywriters, marketers and video-production teams.

blocks.text: Build at least five practical projects during the degree.

blocks.label: Brand launch campaign
blocks.text: Develop a brand identity, audience profile, key message and launch campaign.

blocks.label: Social media strategy
blocks.text: Create a 30-day content calendar for a real or fictional business.

blocks.label: Integrated advertising campaign
blocks.text: Combine digital ads, video, social media and offline promotion.

blocks.label: Consumer insight study
blocks.text: Research a target audience and translate findings into creative concepts.

blocks.label: Campaign performance analysis
blocks.text: Evaluate campaign metrics and recommend improvements.

Each case study should explain the business problem, target audience, research, creative insight, concept, execution and measurable results. Clearly label simulated results rather than presenting them as actual campaign performance.

blocks.text: Explore programmes through IIMC and MICA. Admission requirements, entrance tests, programme availability and fees vary by institution and academic year.

Potential destinations include the UK, USA, Canada, Australia and Singapore. Relevant programmes include advertising, strategic communication, brand management, consumer psychology and integrated marketing communications.
Research university-specific admission requirements, scholarships, tuition costs and work authorisation. An international qualification does not guarantee a job or visa.

blocks.text: These are illustrative planning horizons, not guaranteed promotion timelines.
Rate each skill based on demonstrated work.

blocks.label: Primary recommendation
blocks.text: Develop the ability to turn audience insights into original creative ideas that serve a measurable business objective. A portfolio demonstrating this connection is the strongest starting point for a Creative Strategist career.
